_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the plugin/marketplace identifier sets every PRFlow name discriminator accepts. The CANONICAL plugin name is NOT stored here - it is read live from .claude-plugin/plugin.json's `name` field (a freeze-list value). This file adds only (a) the additional accepted identifiers, and (b) the canonical marketplace name, which lives here because .claude-plugin/marketplace.json is deliberately NOT part of the vendored plugin slice (vendor-slice.sh removes it) and so is unreadable at runtime in a consumer tree. lib/test/run.sh gates marketplace_canonical against the real marketplace.json. Reader: lib/plugin_identity.py. The surfaces that cannot read it at runtime carry a baked copy instead; that set is enumerated by lib/generate-plugin-identity.py's REGIONS table (never re-listed here), and every such copy is GENERATED by that script - never hand-edited.
